spell.create_spellbook.arcane_press.desc: Strike with an arcane press and process dropped inputs at the target.
spell.create_spellbook.power_saw.descrip: Recast piercing sawblades. Log hits fell connected trees. Dropped inputs share one processing budget.
spell.create_spellbook.crushing_wheel.de: Roll a wheel that repeatedly crushes foes and processes dropped items.
spell.create_spellbook.piston_launch.des: Propel yourself with a piston impulse.
spell.create_spellbook.arcane_drill.desc: Pierce foes and obstacles, mining Spectral Hammer blocks and ores along the path. Stone / iron / diamond tiers at levels 1 / 4 / 7; protection respected.
spell.create_spellbook.stress_drive.desc: Channel at an Arcane Crank to provide temporary kinetic power.
spell.create_spellbook.blaze_infusion.de: Temporarily heat an occupied burner, with duration scaled by spell power. Enemy hits add three delayed burns.
spell.create_spellbook.fan_smelting.desc: Channel hot air to hurt foes and continuously smelt 4 to 16 input items per second.
spell.create_spellbook.brass_exoskeleton: Gain temporary armor, attack damage and toughness. Recasting refreshes the effect.
spell.create_spellbook.press_barrage.des: Summon longitudinal presses along the cast direction that slam near-to-far, process dropped inputs at each impact with one shared budget, and inflict Blindness and Slowness V.
spell.create_spellbook.ejection_overload: Launch one target upward on a transient weighted ejector. Its next real fall damage is multiplied once; knockback-immune targets are refused.
spell.create_spellbook.mechanic.descript: A translucent arm follows behind your right shoulder, reaching out for an independent follow-up on successful direct melee hits. Arrows, spells and the arm itself cannot trigger it.
spell.create_spellbook.mechanical_master: For thirty seconds, attack one visible foe every ten ticks with a press, sword arm, flying drill, lava spout, piston or flying saw.
spell.create_spellbook.gear_missile.guid: Instantly launch a spinning arcane cog along your line of sight. Its low mana cost and short cooldown make it a basic mechanical ranged attack. Damage scales with spell level and mechanical spell power.
spell.create_spellbook.arcane_press.guid: After a one-second cast, summon a press at the aimed location to strike enemies. It also processes nearby dropped items using current Create pressing recipes. One cast handles up to 8 inputs at level one, increasing to 64 at maximum level.
spell.create_spellbook.power_saw.guide: Fire a horizontally spinning sawblade that pierces enemies, with more shots available during its recast window. Log impacts fell connected trees, and dropped items can be processed with Create cutting recipes. Recasts share one processing budget and respect block protection.
spell.create_spellbook.crushing_wheel.gu: After a two-second cast, summon a crushing wheel that rolls forward, repeatedly damaging and knocking back enemies in its path. It processes dropped items with Create crushing recipes without breaking world blocks or machinery.
spell.create_spellbook.piston_launch.gui: Instantly project an arcane piston to propel yourself along your current look direction, including upward and downward aim. Use it to advance, retreat or cross terrain. Movement retains normal collision.
spell.create_spellbook.arcane_drill.guid: After a one-second cast, launch a rotating drill that pierces enemies and obstacles. It mines blocks suitable for Spectral Hammer and ores along its path. Levels 1, 4 and 7 reach stone, iron and diamond pickaxe tiers, preserving normal drops and protection checks.
spell.create_spellbook.stress_drive.guid: Channel at an Arcane Crank for up to thirty seconds to temporarily power a Create kinetic network. The tooltip shows actual stress capacity in SU, including mechanical spell power, and output RPM. Capacity keeps growing beyond the normal maximum level. Output stops when its lease expires.
spell.create_spellbook.blaze_infusion.gu: Infuse an occupied Blaze Burner with temporary heat. The level-one base duration is two minutes and scales with mechanical spell power. Against creatures it deals fire damage followed by three delayed burning hits.
spell.create_spellbook.fan_smelting.guid: Channel a hot airflow that scorches enemies ahead and processes dropped items with applicable Create fan recipes. Processing grows from 4 inputs per second at level one to 16 at maximum level. Canceling stops processing, and idle time never stores extra capacity.
spell.create_spellbook.brass_exoskeleton: Equip a temporary brass exoskeleton. Each level grants 2 armor, 2 attack damage and 1 armor toughness, including overleveled casts beyond the normal three levels. The default duration is 210 seconds. Recasting refreshes the effect without stacking attribute bonuses.
spell.create_spellbook.press_barrage.gui: Summon 3 to 8 large press heads in a line extending forward along your horizontal cast direction. They slam from near to far, dealing level-scaled damage and applying two seconds of Blindness and Slowness V. All heads share one Create pressing budget.
spell.create_spellbook.ejection_overload: Project an ejector beneath an aimed enemy and launch it vertically. Height grows from 6 to 16 blocks, while its next effective fall hit within the time limit is multiplied by 1.5 to 2.5. The bonus is consumed once and cannot stack through repeated casts.
spell.create_spellbook.mechanic.guide: A translucent arm follows behind your right shoulder. During the buff, each successful direct melee hit makes it reach out for an independent attack on the same target, dealing 5, 7 or 9 base damage scaled by mechanical spell power. Arrows, spells and the arm itself cannot trigger it.
spell.create_spellbook.mechanical_master: Become a Mechanical Master and automatically attack nearby visible hostiles. By default, the buff lasts thirty seconds and launches one random press, sword arm, flying drill, lava spout, piston or flying saw attack every ten ticks. All six attacks scale with mechanical spell power and gain direct damage from overlevels. Projections may overlap without damaging buildings.
tooltip.create_spellbook.master_direct_d: Theoretical direct DPS: %s (includes spell power; excludes burns and falls)
tooltip.create_spellbook.blood_bucket: Contains 1000 mB of blood. Fill or empty using a Spout, Item Drain or Alchemist Cauldron.
tooltip.create_spellbook.focusing_basin: Condense spell damage into mana. Connect Create pipes to transfer it.
tooltip.create_spellbook.arcane_depot: A reskinned Create Depot. Both depots accept spell processing.
tooltip.create_spellbook.spell_sensor: Emit redstone on spell contact. Sneak with an empty hand to cycle schools.
tooltip.create_spellbook.arcane_casting_: Bottom shaft; mana inlet on the right. Right-click with a scroll to insert or replace; empty hand retrieves it. Wrench cycles pulse, turret and processing modes.
tooltip.create_spellbook.arcane_reactor: Right-click with a scroll to configure; empty hand retrieves it. Attack visible hostiles. 1000 mB mana, +1 mB/tick; rear inlet accepts mana without extraction.
message.create_spellbook.construct_owner: Only the owner can configure or recover this construct.
gui.create_spellbook.construct.interval: Cast interval (hold or scroll; Shift for larger steps)
gui.create_spellbook.construct.status.un: Spell cannot be cast by constructs
gui.create_spellbook.construct.mode_help: Cast once per rising edge; polarity can be inverted. Busy, cooldown or resource-limited pulses are not queued.
Aim at the nearest visible hostile. By default a high redstone signal stops automatic modes.
Cast at a matching depot along the forward line, at the same height or one block lower. Requires compatible input, spell level and output space.
message.create_spellbook.construct_unsup: This spell cannot be cast by a machine: %s
tooltip.create_spellbook.scroll_printer: Top ink inlet; front scroll or allow-list filter template; school focus in the head. Place two blocks above a depot or belt. Each print consumes paper, one focus and ink. The template is retained; ink determines the output level.
message.create_spellbook.printer_templat: Insert a spell scroll or an allow-list filter containing scrolls. Templates select spells; ink determines the native scribing level.
message.create_spellbook.printer_focus: The head needs the school's scribing material, such as a divine pearl or cogwheel; one is consumed per print.
message.create_spellbook.printer_native_: Ink sets the native scribing level; allow-listed spells print in rotation.
Place two blocks above a depot or belt; leave the gap clear.
Use the side panel for a scroll or allow-list filter; the original front automation inlet remains available.
Right-click the bottom or sides of the print head to insert school materials; use an empty hand on the head to retrieve them.
Top ink inlet. Each print uses paper and ink; ink sets the scroll level.
tooltip.create_spellbook.arcane_casing: Cubic reactor frame, side 5..19. All twelve edges use casing.
tooltip.create_spellbook.arcane_reinforc: Non-edge reactor shell window. Displays the field and shared mana level.
tooltip.create_spellbook.reactor_output: Extract shared collapsed matter. A full buffer causes field growth.
tooltip.create_spellbook.reactor_mana_in: Exterior liquid-mana input; every inlet shares the controller tank. Extraction is disabled.
tooltip.create_spellbook.reactor_control: Field size, matched cores and storage. Stabilizer capacity (side-2)^2, paginated. While switched on, living entities inside take magic damage (10 per second by default). Switching off stops it immediately.
tooltip.create_spellbook.reactor_port: Exterior stabilizer input. At least one per pair; each pair costs 1 durability/second.
tooltip.create_spellbook.black_hole_reac: Top face or directly below its shell. Each matched pair consumes 5 mB mana/tick.
tooltip.create_spellbook.black_hole_ener: Bottom face or directly above its shell. Each pair provides 4096 SU per 1% field size.
tooltip.create_spellbook.black_hole_reac: Install one outward-facing shaft on a side wall to connect Create kinetics.
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.edge: Every edge must be Arcane Casing
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.interior: Keep the chamber air except for valid roof/floor-mounted cores.
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.reaction_: Mount reaction cores on or directly below the roof; do not stack both forms.
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.energy_co: Mount energy cores on or directly above the floor; do not stack both forms.
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.shaft: One outward-facing shaft is required on a side face
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.controlle: Controller must be on a side face, pointing out
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.missing_b: A functional block entity is missing
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.shared_co: A functional component belongs to another reactor
message.create_spellbook.reactor.foundat: No material transfer, mana use, energy production or accidents in this phase.
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.missing_m: At least one Reactor Mana Interface is required
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.missing_s: At least one black-hole stabilizer port is required
reactor.create_spellbook.issue.missing_o: At least one Reactor Output is required
tooltip.create_spellbook.black_hole_stab: Reactor stabilizer; accounted wear ignores enchantments. Cannot be enchanted or repaired.
gui.create_spellbook.reactor.legacy: Warning: %s legacy waste awaiting transfer; export the buffer.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.structure: Warning: structure incomplete or required chunks unavailable.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.no_mana: Mana shortage: field and capacity are shrinking.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.stabilize: Unstable: insufficient stabilizers. Startup is allowed, but containment will worsen.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.waste_ful: Waste buffer full: field growing. Export waste.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.legacy_wa: Warning: legacy port storage pending; export waste.
tooltip.create_spellbook.collapsed_matte: Reactor waste: fire, lava, cactus, natural despawn and the void cannot dispose of it. Store securely.
message.create_spellbook.waste_drop: Warning: dropped collapsed matter will persist. Recover and store it.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.runaway: Danger: containment lost. Repairs can no longer retract this accident.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.terminal: Danger: terminal collapse. Leave the reactor area.
reactor.create_spellbook.alarm.no_cores: Structure formed. Add at least one reaction/energy core pair to start.
recipe.create_spellbook.spell_applicatio: Apply the shown scroll spell using an Arcane Spell Emitter
create_spellbook.ponder.tag.arcane_engin: Spells wired into Create kinetics, logistics and fluid networks.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.reactor_a: A Black Hole Reactor is a cube of Arcane Casing, 5 to 19 blocks on each side.
Start with the floor. All twelve edges must be Arcane Casing.
Place the Energy Core in the centre of the floor, or directly above it.
Build the walls layer by layer. Non-edge panels can be Reinforced Arcane Glass.
Mount one Controller on a side face, facing outwards.
The Mana Interface accepts liquid mana. Multiple interfaces share one tank.
The Stabilizer Port only accepts Black Hole Stabilizers.
The Output Port only exports Collapsed Matter.
Continue upwards and close the roof.
The Reaction Core sits in the centre of the roof, or just below it. It pairs with the Energy Core.
Mount exactly one Reaction Shaft on a side face, pointing into your kinetic network.
Right-click the Controller to open its panel. Sneak-right-click to re-check the structure.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.reactor_o: Once the structure is formed, right-click the Controller.
Liquid mana is pumped into the Mana Interface. The whole reactor shares one tank.
Each core pair consumes 100 mB of mana per second by default.
Each core pair needs one Black Hole Stabilizer and wears 1 durability per second.
Press Start. The field grows smoothly from 0%% to 50%%.
At 50%%, each pair provides 204,800 SU; the Reaction Shaft outputs 256 RPM by default.
Collapsed Matter leaves through the Output Port. The shared buffer holds 1,024 items.
Running out of mana only shrinks the field. It does not cause an accident.
Press Stop to shrink the field smoothly back to zero.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.reactor_s: Missing stabilizers, a full waste buffer, or a broken structure starts instability.
While unstable, the field grows by 0.1%% every 5 ticks, raising stress too.
100%% is still contained. Only above 100%% does it escape.
From a healthy 50%%, that takes about 125 seconds.
Repair the structure, refill the stabilizers and clear the waste before then to recover.
Once it escapes, the black hole devours blocks and creatures, and the reactor cannot stop it.
Keep fuel and waste space topped up; prevention is far more reliable than repair.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.casting_s: The Arcane Casting Arm takes rotation from a shaft below it.
It will not start a cast when rotation is too low or the network is overstressed.
Feed liquid mana into its right side. The internal tank holds 1,000 mB by default.
Right-click with a spell scroll to insert it; right-click empty-handed to take it back.
Inserting consumes one scroll. Casting does not consume the template.
Use a Create wrench to cycle its three modes.
Pulse mode casts once on each redstone rising edge.
Casts spend liquid mana equal to the scroll's mana cost; 1 mana is 1 mB by default.
Cooldowns are tracked per spell. Swapping scrolls does not skip them.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.casting_m: The wrench cycles Redstone Pulse, Auto Turret, and Arcane Processing.
Pulse mode casts straight ahead and needs no target.
Turret mode locks onto hostile creatures within 16 blocks that it can see.
Processing mode casts at a depot 2–16 blocks ahead, on the same level or one below.
The item on the depot must match a spell processing recipe.
On a hit the input is consumed and the result enters the depot's output buffer.
Belts can be targets too, but a fast belt may carry the item out of the spell's path.
All three modes need rotation and mana. Switching modes does not reset cooldowns.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_int: The Focusing Basin turns damaging spells that hit it into liquid mana.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_dam: Only spells that deal damage produce mana.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_rat: By default, each point of spell damage becomes 10 mB of mana.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_cap: Its default capacity is 2,000 mB. Once full, extra damage is discarded.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_pip: Every side can connect to Create fluid pipes.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_sto: Pump the mana into a tank, or fill a bucket directly.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_rea: Right-click empty-handed to check the stored amount.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.basin_not: It only collects; it never casts spells on its own.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_int: The Arcane Depot keeps the item handling, logistics and comparator behaviour of a Create Depot.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_pla: Place the ingredient you want to process on the depot.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_arm: Put an Arcane Casting Arm at least 2 blocks in front, with a clear line of sight.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_rec: The spell and the ingredient must match a spell processing recipe.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_exa: For example, Eldritch Blast turns an Amethyst Shard into an Echo Shard.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_res: On a hit the ingredient is consumed and the result enters the depot's output buffer.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_aut: Funnels, mechanical arms or belts can take the result away.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.depot_van: A regular Create Depot can run the same spell processing.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_s: Place the Scroll Printer two blocks above a depot or belt, leaving the gap empty.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_n: It needs no rotation: only ink, a template and a school focus.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_t: Insert a spell scroll as the template; the template is not consumed.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_f: Put the matching school focus on the other side, such as a Blaze Rod for Fire.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_i: Feed liquid ink into the top; the ink quality sets the printed scroll level.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_p: Place paper on the depot or belt below.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_c: Each sheet uses one ink portion and one focus, and the result drops onto the depot.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_f: A whitelist filter can hold several scrolls and cycles through them.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.printer_n: The space under the print head must stay empty; an obstruction stops printing.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_no: The Arcane Auto Caster needs no rotation and no stress.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_sc: Right-click with a spell scroll to insert it; right-click empty-handed to take it back.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_ma: The rear face only accepts liquid mana; the internal tank holds 1,000 mB by default.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_re: While loaded it recovers 1 mB per tick, stopping when full.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_au: Every 10 ticks it looks for a visible hostile creature within 16 blocks.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_co: Once it finds a target, it casts with the scroll's normal mana, cast time and cooldown.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_li: It never attacks players, pets or allies, and cannot drain its mana back into pipes.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.caster_no: It only fights; it does not fuel the basin, processing devices or sensor.
create_spellbook.ponder.shared.reactor_a: Missing stabilizers, a full waste buffer or a broken structure starts instability.
The field grows by 0.1%% every 5 ticks, and stress rises with it.
Above 100%%, the black hole escapes and the reactor can no longer shut it down.
An escaped black hole devours nearby blocks, dropped items and creatures.
Before that point, repair the structure, refill stabilizers and clear waste to recover.
This segment only shows alarms and effects; no real accident is created in your save.
Treat stabilizers and waste space as routine maintenance, not a repair after the fact.
